correctness.rationale: The final theorem conditions the Fu–Xie–Li unit-pair integrand Phi_X(x,y) on r=min(||x+y||,||x-y||)/max in (0,1]. After y↦−y assume a=||x+y||≥b=||x−y||=ra. The exact identity Phi=(a+b)/(2ab)||b(x+y)−a(x−y)|| and triangle inequality yield Phi≤(1+r)(2+a(1−r)/2)=(1+r)(2−r) after a≤2. For every 0<r≤1, x_r=(1,1−2r), y=(1,1) in real ℓ∞² realize a=2,b=2r and Phi=(1+r)(2−r), so the continuum of conditional suprema is attained. Tracing equality at the global 9/4 yields r=1/2,a=2,b=1 and ||3σy−x||=3 with sign σ; converse directly attains 9/4. The exact near-extremizer stability |r−1/2|≤sqrt(delta) follows from the polynomial gap and is sharp. Verified rational samples r=1/80,1/2,4/5,1 by a separate exact-norm implementation, supplementary to the continuum proof.
